description: How long a credential stays valid, and -- on the JavaScript side -- a window opened without cutting the reference back to the page that opened it. Both negatives are the discriminators: a preference cookie that lasts a year is a feature, and a lifetime is only long relative to the unit the call counts in.

expected.note: a year in SECONDS, which is the same year the Express fixture writes in milliseconds -- the threshold belongs to the call, not to the keyword
